title: SiGMA Central Europe B2C Awards 2025
excerpt: Two industry nominations, one shared mission. A close look at the SiGMA Central Europe B2C Awards 2025, what the recognition means for the team, and what comes next.
introHtml:
We are honored to have been recognized at the SiGMA Central Europe B2C Awards 2025 with two prestigious nominations: Best Affiliate Network 2025 and Best Workplace 2025. These results highlight the work of our partners, advertisers, and internal team that put quality and trust before short-term results.

Awards are a checkpoint, not a finish line. They confirm that the strategy of long-term relationships, transparent reporting, and product-driven affiliate experiences keeps moving the industry forward.

sections.title: Why These Nominations Matter
sections.bodyHtml:
The SiGMA Awards bring together the strongest operators, networks, and platforms across Central Europe. A nomination is the result of operator votes, partner feedback, and an independent committee — it reflects how the market sees the brand from the outside.

For us, these two nominations send a clear signal: a healthy product, a stable team, and partner-first thinking are the combination that keeps an affiliate network competitive year over year.

subsections.title: What we believe drives this kind of recognition:
subsections.bodyHtml:
• Long-term partnerships instead of one-off campaigns
  • Transparent payouts and predictable terms
  • A team that truly owns the partner experience
  • Data and reporting that partners can trust

sections.title: What Comes Next for the Network
sections.bodyHtml:
The next twelve months are about scaling the things that worked: cleaner partner onboarding, better creative kits, faster financial workflows, and richer analytics for our advertisers. Recognition is fuel, not the destination — the bar moves with every product cycle.

If you want to learn more about our partner programs and the brands we work with, take a look at affiliate.makeberry.com and reach out to the team directly.
